join_key: pin_id + layer (SAM-01 exists in both ot-digs and nt-digs; composite ids kept whole)
wire_notes: Details drawer: directly below the dig/open status line, show 'Travel advisory: Level N, <level_label>'.
In the drawer's advisory section show the blurb, then 'State Dept, updated <updated>', then the url as a link to travel.state.gov. Do not paste or rehost advisory body text.
Pins with advisory_name null show nothing (no line, no section).
Join on pin_id AND layer: SAM-01 appears in both OT and NT layers (both map to West Bank).
note/review fields are for the team; do not render them in the drawer.
